decisions.reason: As a multi-model trailer line close to the firm's core business, the car transporter has accumulated investment and organizational commitment that management would be reluctant to abandon absent clear evidence of lasting failure.
The low-bed trailer series is a highly visible core product, so sunk costs, public commitment, and fit with the firm's transport focus strongly favor continued support.

Although the high trailer cover series is somewhat more peripheral than a full trailer, it complements the main range and prior public positioning makes management more likely to retain it than withdraw it.
This box car trailer series sits squarely in the firm's main product area, and after several years of commitment management would likely continue rather than reverse course quickly.
